root_cause.text: The `TIF_SVE` thread flag was not set during ptrace writes to the SVE regset on systems supporting SVE but not SME because the flag-setting logic was erroneously guarded by a `system_supports_sme()` check.
root_cause.evidence: The patch removes the `if (system_supports_sme())` wrapper around the `switch` statement in `sve_set_common()` in `arch/arm64/kernel/ptrace.c`, ensuring `set_tsk_thread_flag(target, TIF_SVE)` executes unconditionally for SVE writes rather than only when SME is supported.

intent_record.intent_summary: Removed an unnecessary hardware capability check that was incorrectly gating SVE/SME streaming mode configuration
intent_record.what: Removed the outer 'if (system_supports_sme())' conditional wrapper around the switch statement that configures SVE/SME streaming mode flags
intent_record.how: The SVE/SME configuration code now executes unconditionally instead of being gated by hardware SME support detection, allowing the type-based flag setting to always run regardless of system capabilities
